tours.name: Review Team Attendance and Overtime
tours.description: Learn how a manager checks when the team checks in and out, how many hours each person worked, how much overtime they have, and how attendance trends over recent weeks.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how a manager checks when the team checks in and out, how many hours each person worked, how much overtime they have, and how attendance trends over recent weeks.

steps.title: Open Attendances
steps.description: The Attendances app records when each employee checks in and out. Managers use it to review working hours and overtime for the team.

description_i18n.en_US: The Attendances app records when each employee checks in and out. Managers use it to review working hours and overtime for the team.

steps.title: Team timeline
steps.content: This timeline shows each day of the period. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: This timeline shows each day of the period. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The timeline lays out every person's check-in and check-out times along the days, so you can see who worked when.

description_i18n.en_US: The timeline lays out every person's check-in and check-out times along the days, so you can see who worked when.

steps.title: List view
steps.content: Click List to see the attendance records as a table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click List to see the attendance records as a table.

steps.description: The list shows every attendance record in detail. It is the best place to check exact times and totals.

description_i18n.en_US: The list shows every attendance record in detail. It is the best place to check exact times and totals.

steps.title: Employee totals
steps.content: Click an employee's name to open their records.

content_i18n.en_US: Click an employee's name to open their records.

steps.description: Records are grouped by employee. The totals on each group line add up that person's work hours and overtime, and the number in brackets is how many records they have.

description_i18n.en_US: Records are grouped by employee. The totals on each group line add up that person's work hours and overtime, and the number in brackets is how many records they have.

steps.title: Work Hours
steps.content: The Work Hours column shows the time between check-in and check-out. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: The Work Hours column shows the time between check-in and check-out. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Work Hours is calculated for you from the check-in and check-out times. Click the heading to sort the records by hours worked.

description_i18n.en_US: Work Hours is calculated for you from the check-in and check-out times. Click the heading to sort the records by hours worked.

steps.title: Over Time
steps.content: The Over Time column shows the extra hours worked. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: The Over Time column shows the extra hours worked. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Over Time shows the hours an employee worked beyond their normal schedule. Click the heading to sort and find who has the most overtime.

description_i18n.en_US: Over Time shows the hours an employee worked beyond their normal schedule. Click the heading to sort and find who has the most overtime.

steps.title: Reporting
steps.content: Open Reporting to see attendance trends.

content_i18n.en_US: Open Reporting to see attendance trends.

steps.description: Reporting turns the records into a chart so you can compare employees and weeks instead of reading individual lines.

description_i18n.en_US: Reporting turns the records into a chart so you can compare employees and weeks instead of reading individual lines.

steps.title: Chart settings
steps.content: These tags show the period and grouping of the chart. Click one to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: These tags show the period and grouping of the chart. Click one to continue.

steps.description: By default the chart covers the last three months, with a bar per week and employee. You can change the period or grouping from the search options.

description_i18n.en_US: By default the chart covers the last three months, with a bar per week and employee. You can change the period or grouping from the search options.

steps.title: Pivot view
steps.content: Click Pivot to see the same figures in a table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Pivot to see the same figures in a table.

steps.description: The pivot table shows the numbers behind the chart, which is useful for comparing employees side by side or copying figures into a report.

description_i18n.en_US: The pivot table shows the numbers behind the chart, which is useful for comparing employees side by side or copying figures into a report.
